content:
GOAL: pick a coupling position for the round prescription "curvature only at the shallow levels, deep levels exactly baseline".
READ/OBSERVED: from the round brief + earlier arm measurements: baseline l3_collision=0.2745, level2_distinct_prefixes=7414, valid_l1_hard_er=6.468; GEOCAP 3.885/0.1222/L2 4236/l3 0.549; OCCURV 2.488/0.2629/L2 784/l3 0.943; strataot 2.755/0.1819/L2 720/l3 0.960. Conclusion I draw: every rejected arm damaged the DEEP residual (barycentre/capacity/per-layer field changes), while shallow separation itself was achievable (OCCURV hit 0.2629). Sinkhorn failure shows the deep crowding was not allocator imbalance.
REASONING: so the safe mechanism must (a) keep levels 2-3 literally the baseline code, (b) get shallow separation from a curved assignment, (c) make behaviour enter the SAME score as the curved distance, not a side loss. I rejected per-codeword radii (GEOCAP shape), reach-as-curvature (OCCURV shape), per-layer curvature + successor centroids + Sinkhorn (strataot shape). Chosen new shapes: (i) popularity-adjusted (Dice) directed successor distribution of each item over level-1 codes, compressed to a measured concentration alpha_x, forming a hyperbolic continuation anchor b_x; (ii) a single level-1 score S(k)=(1-alpha)d_P(u1,ek)^2 + alpha d_P(ek,bx)^2 evaluated on a geometric shortlist M=8; (iii) a curved shallow residual hand-off v1 = PT_{e_k0->0}(log_{e_k0}(u0)) = log/(1-kappa||e||^2) so levels 2-3 see a common origin frame with their baseline Euclidean recursion unchanged; kappa derived from measured RMS scale sigma of training encoder outputs. All curvature is identically zero for level>=2; no Sinkhorn; no cross-graph transport.
STILL OPEN: nothing blocking; risk that alpha_x is small for most items (coupling near-inert) and risk that the predictive pull inflates ||v1|| and re-crowds the deep codes - both recorded as risks with the shortlist and concentration-derived alpha as the only limits.

IDEA: shalcurv-cont-anchor-rq
TITLE: Shallow-only Poincare curvature with a behaviour continuation anchor: hyperbolic level-0/1 assignment and a log-map hand-off, deep levels byte-identical baseline
MOTIVATION: The three rejected arms (GEOCAP, OCCURV-FIELD, strataot) all bought shallow separation at the price of deep collapse (l3_collision 0.549/0.943/0.960 vs baseline 0.2745, L2 prefixes 4236/784/720 vs 7414). Separately, RQ-VAE SIDs describe an item's content but not where the sequence goes, so Stage 3 has to learn next-SID prediction from prefixes that carry no behavioural information. This idea isolates curvature in the shallow chart, keeps levels 2-3 literally the baseline recursion, and makes the level-1 code continuation-aware so the item's prefix already encodes its likely continuations.
NOVELTY: Not per-codeword capacity radii from behaviour demand (GEOCAP), not reach-as-curvature occupancy cells (OCCURV), not per-layer curvature with successor code centroids and Sinkhorn (strataot). New here: (a) a popularity-adjusted, Dice-normalised directed successor distribution, compressed per item into a measured concentration alpha_x, forms a hyperbolic continuation anchor b_x; (b) one convex score S(k) mixes the geodesic residual distance with the geodesic anchor distance, evaluated on a geometric shortlist of M=8 codewords, so behaviour can only reorder inside the geometric neighbourhood; (c) the shallow residual is handed to the deep levels through a log-map + parallel-transport pair anchored at the chosen level-0 code, so the shared deep codebooks see residual vectors in one common origin frame; (d) curvature is exactly zero for level>=2 (no Sinkhorn, no cross-graph transport).
CHANGE: Levels 0 and 1 are quantised with Poincare geodesic distances and exp/log/parallel-transport on a ball of fixed curvature -kappa, and level 1 is chosen by a single score that adds a behaviour continuation-anchor term; levels 2 and 3 keep the baseline Euclidean argmin and residual recursion unchanged, receiving only the transported shallow residual.
SPECIFICATION: sigma = RMS norm of encoder outputs over epoch 1 (detached, frozen); kappa = 1/sigma^2, ball radius sigma. u0 = exp_0(z); k0 = argmin_k d_P(u0,e_{0,k})^2; v1 = log_{e_{0,k0}}(u0)/(1-kappa*||e_{0,k0}||^2) (= PT_{e_k0->0}); u1 = exp_0(v1); C = the M=8 codewords with smallest d_P(u1,e_{1,k}); p_x, alpha_x and b_x from the frozen train transition table (see BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION); S(k) = (1-alpha_x)*d_P(u1,e_{1,k})^2 + alpha_x*d_P(e_{1,k},b_x)^2; k1 = argmin_{k in C} S(k). Then s1 = v1 - e_{1,k1} and for l=2,3: k_l = argmin_k ||s_{l-1}-e_{l,k}||^2, s_l = s_{l-1}-e_{l,k_l} (baseline, untouched). Reconstruction: u0_hat = exp_{e_{0,k0}}((1-kappa*||e_{0,k0}||^2)*sum_{l>=1} e_{l,k_l}), z_hat = log_0(u0_hat), loss = ||z-z_hat||^2 with the code indices detached (straight-through); assignment and reconstruction use the same codeword positions at every level.
COST: Stage-2 step (B=1024, D=32, K=256): baseline 3 argmins ~2.5e7 MACs; added level-0/level-1 Poincare distances ~1.7e8 MACs, exp/log/PT O(B*D), shortlist O(B*8): under 3% of Stage-2 step time, ~0% at Stage 3. Behaviour tables rebuilt once per epoch (24 steps), O(E) with E = train transition count: negligible over 3000 epochs = 72000 steps. No extra forward pass, no extra loss, no extra parameters beyond the same 4 codebooks.
HYPOTHESIS: If shallow curvature plus behaviour-only shortlist reordering preserves deep dispersion, the run should show vali

d_l1_hard_er <= 4 and hit >= 0.12 with l3_collision <= 0.35 and level2_distinct_prefixes in the 7414 range, and Stage3 test Recall@10 above the 0.065 target; observable as (i) the fraction of items whose coupled level-1 argmin differs from the geometric argmin being materially above 0 while p95 of ||v1||/sigma stays bounded, and (ii) the train-only prefix->next-prefix predictability of the level-1 code rising relative to the geometric assignment.
RISKS: 1) The predictive pull inflates the shallow residual, deep residual norms grow and l3_collision climbs past 0.35 - the exact failure of OCCURV/strataot; the M=8 shortlist and concentration-derived alpha are the only limits. 2) Successor distributions are diffuse, so alpha_x is small for most items and the SIDs barely move, reproducing baseline 0.0555 instead of beating 0.065. 3) Hub items with concentrated successors are pulled hard, many of their level-1 codes collapse onto one anchor, hurting level2_distinct_prefixes. 4) Poincare operators near the boundary go non-finite if kappa is overestimated from a noisy first epoch. 5) The anchor table depends on the previous epoch's frozen level-1 codes, so an early collapse can lock in a bad table. 6) With one run and no ablations the benefit cannot be attributed if the result lands between arms.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Popularity-adjusted directed successor distribution of each training item over level-1 codewords, together with its normalised-entropy concentration.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: From the TRAIN split only: count consecutive pairs c(i->j) inside each user history; Dice-normalise w(i->j) = c(i->j)/(deg(i)+deg(j)) so hub successors are downweighted; map successors to codewords with the frozen (detached, previous-epoch) level-1 assignment l1 and set p_i[k] = sum_{j:l1(j)=k} w(i->j) / sum_j w(i->j); alpha_i = clip(1 - H(p_i)/log K1, 0, 1) with H the Shannon entropy, and alpha_i = 0 for items with no outgoing train transition. Tables are rebuilt at each epoch boundary from train data only and are never differentiated.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: The transition table, the kappa scale and the frozen l1 map are functions of Stage-2 training sequences and of encoder outputs on training items only; validation and test sequences are never read during SID construction, and the test split is touched only by the frozen Stage-3 protocol after SIDs are fixed. Items without train transitions get alpha = 0 (no behaviour term), so no test interaction can alter a code.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Poincare ball of fixed negative curvature -kappa with kappa = 1/sigma^2 derived from the measured RMS scale sigma of training encoder outputs (ball radius sigma, metric factor 4 convention): Moebius addition, geodesic distance d_P(x,y) = (2/sqrt(kappa))*artanh(sqrt(kappa)*||(-x)(+)y||), exp_0/log_0, parallel transport PT_{e->0}(v) = v/(1-kappa*||e||^2) and its inverse (1-kappa*||e||^2)*v, and the tangent-space hyperbolic mean exp_0(sum_k p_k log_0(e_k)).
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: In the quantizer and in training: the level-0 and level-1 codebook assignment (geodesic distance), and the shallow residual hand-off v1 that is delivered to the deep codebooks (log map plus parallel transport). Levels 2 and 3 run with kappa = 0, i.e. plain Euclidean argmin and baseline residual recursion.
COUPLING PATH: Behaviour builds p_x, alpha_x and b_x; those three numbers and vectors enter the single level-1 score S(k) that also contains the geodesic distance d_P; the argmin of S selects k1, which fixes the tra

nsported shallow residual v1 - e_{1,k1}, the deep codes and the reconstruction. Removing behaviour (alpha = 0, b unused) reduces the score to the pure geodesic argmin; removing curvature reduces d_P, exp/log and PT to their kappa->0 limits and the whole quantizer to baseline RQ. Neither half can be deleted without changing the chosen code.
COUPLING EQUATION: S(k|x) = (1 - alpha_x)*d_P(u1, e_{1,k})^2 + alpha_x*d_P(e_{1,k}, b_x)^2 with b_x = exp_0( sum_k p_x[k]*log_0(e_{1,k}) ) and alpha_x = clip(1 - H(p_x)/log K1, 0, 1).
OBSERVABLES: valid_l1_hard_er (bar <= 4, expect 2.5-4), positive hit rate (bar >= 0.12), l3_collision (bar <= 0.35), level2_distinct_prefixes (not below the 7414 order of magnitude), p50/p95 of ||v1||/sigma and of ||s1||/sigma, the fraction of items whose coupled level-1 argmin differs from the geometric argmin, train-only prefix->next-prefix predictability of the level-1 code, and Stage3 test Recall@10 (target > 0.065 against baseline 0.0555).
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: alpha_x set to 0 and b_x unused, so the level-1 code is the pure geodesic argmin over the ball and only the curved shallow chart plus the log-map hand-off remain; isolates the behaviour contribution.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: kappa -> 0 exact limits: d_P becomes squared Euclidean distance, log becomes subtraction, PT becomes identity, the hyperbolic mean becomes the weighted Euclidean mean, and exp_0 becomes identity, with the behaviour terms still switched on; isolates curvature.
ABLATION BOTH ON: The full coupled run described in SPECIFICATION - the only arm actually trained (one run, frozen 3000-epoch Stage-2 budget, frozen Stage-3 protocol, no early stopping, no sweep, no multi-seed).
SPEC EQUATIONS: sigma = rms(||z||) over epoch 1, frozen; kappa = 1/sigma^2. exp_0(v) = tanh(sqrt(kappa)*||v||/2)*v/(sqrt(kappa)*||v||); log_0(u) = (2/sqrt(kappa))*artanh(sqrt(kappa)*||u||)*u/||u||. x(+)y = ((1+2k<x,y>+k||y||^2)x + (1-k||x||^2)y)/(1+2k<x,y>+k^2||x||^2||y||^2), k=kappa. d_P(x,y) = (2/sqrt(kappa))*artanh(sqrt(kappa)*||(-x)(+)y||). u0=exp_0(z); k0=argmin_k d_P(u0,e_{0,k})^2; v1=log_{e_{0,k0}}(u0)/(1-kappa*||e_{0,k0}||^2); u1=exp_0(v1); C=shortlist_M8(u1); p_x,alpha_x,b_x as above; S(k) as above; k1=argmin_{k in C} S(k); s1=v1-e_{1,k1}; k_l=argmin_k||s_{l-1}-e_{l,k}||^2, s_l=s_{l-1}-e_{l,k_l} for l=2,3; u0_hat=exp_{e_{0,k0}}((1-kappa*||e_{0,k0}||^2)*(e_{1,k1}+e_{2,k2}+e_{3,k3})); z_hat=log_0(u0_hat); L=||z-z_hat||^2 (plus the baseline commitment term if present). Backward: indices detached (straight-through), shallow exp/log/PT differentiated exactly in z and in e_{0,*,1,*}.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: Inputs: encoder output z in R^32 per training item, the four codebooks, the train-only transition table and the frozen level-1 map, hyperparameters (K=256 per level, M=8, kappa). Outputs: codes (k0,k1,k2,k3) at fixed codeword positions, reconstruction z_hat and the RQ-VAE loss; side outputs per item: p_x (sparse), alpha_x, b_x, ||v1||, and the coupled-vs-geometric disagreement flag.
SAFEGUARDS: Clip every codebook row to ||e|| <= 0.9*sigma after each optimiser step; clamp artanh arguments to <= 1-1e-7 and arcosh arguments to >= 1+1e-7; floor kappa at 1e-6 and never recompute sigma after epoch 1; normalise p_x with an epsilon of 1e-12 and clip alpha_x to [0,1]; if any shallow operator returns a non-finite value for a batch, fall back to the Euclidean branch for that batch and log it (no tuning); M=8 is fixed a priori from the 3-bit level-1 shortlist width, not searched; reco

rd p50/p95 residual norms every 100 steps; no extra loss terms, warm-ups, sweeps, ablations or seed repetitions.
END IDEA
